_comment: Measured on the test rig's LRCP imx307_03 (uvcvideo) at 640x480, indoor light. p95 = 95th percentile luma of the frame. Two sweeps: exposure with gain pinned, and gain with exposure pinned. Recorded because the response is NOT what an open-loop model would assume: gain=0 already gives p95=39 (unity gain, not zero), and doubling exposure raises p95 by ~1.7x rather than 2x because the ISP applies gamma. Both facts are why brightness has to be measured rather than computed.
